page.layout: One printed page. At the top, a centred italic introductory statement of four lines. Below it, the errata list in the main column, one line per entry, ending with a centred closing line. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.

main_text.head: Quoniam in paginarum numeris interdum erratum eft, errores per singula capita, addita eorum pagina, & linea ordine scribere voluimus. Sic igi-tur ipsos emendabis.

page.notes: The Greek on the line "pag.2.l.…" (after C.10.p.1.l.21) is not legible at this scan resolution and is marked as illegible. Several Latin forms are kept as printed, including "eadé", "nõ", "aêtu", and the hyphenated "Quin-etiam". The "ę" in "ętiam" is read as "e". The "C.2." entry is printed as "C.2. partis fecundæ" and is copied unchanged.
